findings.observed: banner-en.png (« Financing that fits your plans / Competitive rates. Clear terms. No surprises. »)
findings.expected: Use a French banner (banner-fr.png): « Un financement adapté à vos projets — Taux concurrentiels. Modalités claires. Aucune surprise. »
findings.description: The French landing page uses the English banner image, which shows English text.
The footer is in English on the French site.
The subtitle uses the informal « tu » while the rest of the site (e.g. the heading « qui vous ressemble ») uses « vous ».
« Appliquer pour » is an anglicism (calque of "apply for") that the OQLF flags; the standard term is « faire une demande de prêt » / « Demander un prêt ».

findings.expected: Let the button grow to fit its text (remove the fixed width / overflow hidden), or shorten it to « Soumettre la demande ».
findings.description: The French submit button label is clipped (scrollWidth 290 > clientWidth 210, overflow hidden, nowrap), so only « Soumettre ma demande » is visible.
The required-field error under « Nom complet » is in English while the other fields show the French message.
The label uses « e-mail » (not standard Quebec usage), while the validation message for the same field says « adresse courriel »; the term should be « courriel » throughout.

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande de 15 000,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The confirmation shows the raw template variable {montant} instead of the amount; the French key name was probably translated, so it no longer matches the variable the code supplies.
The transactions section heading on the French dashboard is in English.
The French transaction dates use the US MM/DD/YYYY format, which is ambiguous for fr-CA readers; the English page uses ISO dates.
In French, zero takes the singular; the English plural rule was applied to the French count.
« Balance » for an account balance is an anglicism in Quebec banking; the correct term is « solde ».
A bank "statement" is a « relevé »; « déclaration » means a declaration or tax return, so the label is wrong in context.
On the French dashboard, the « Estimer un nouveau prêt » link goes to the English calculator page.
The option is translated as "Pay now", the opposite of "Pay later", and it contradicts its own help text (« Premier paiement reporté de 30 jours »).
The estimated monthly payment uses the English currency format on the French page.

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais ne s'appliquent en cas de remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "Charges" (fees) was translated as « accusation » (a criminal charge), which makes no sense here.

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: The French rate note drops the "subject to credit approval" condition.

findings.observed: promo-c.png (image text « Taux fixe : 4,9 % », alt « Taux variable : 5,2 % »)
findings.expected: Use a French version of promo-a showing « Taux variable : 5,2 % »
findings.description: The French promo image says "Fixed rate: 4.9%", which contradicts its alt text, the rate shown on the page and the English image (variable rate of 5.2%).
"Close" (the verb) was translated as the adjective « Proche » (near), which is meaningless as a close button.
The French application confirmation page declares its language as English, while the other French pages declare fr-CA.

findings.expected: Parse amounts written in fr-CA format (space as thousands separator, comma as decimal separator).
findings.description: A valid in-range amount typed in French format (12 500,50) is rejected as out of range on the French form, so the amount parser only accepts English-style numbers.

findings.observed: Not Found — The requested URL was not found on the server. If you entered the URL manually please check your spelling and try again.
findings.expected: Page introuvable — La page demandée n'existe pas. Si vous avez saisi l'adresse manuellement, vérifiez l'orthographe et réessayez.
findings.description: The 404 page under /fr/ is the server's default English error page, not localized and without the site layout.
